title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming formatting, function calls
author: Jordan Liu
description: Summary: Implement OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity across the compatibility layer. This PR updates parameter handling (roles, stop tokens, logprobs mapping), streaming output chunk formatting, and function/tool-calling semantics to match OpenAI behavior. Motivation: customers expect identical semantics when switching from OpenAI APIs to Redwood's compatibility layer; several downstream SDKs and end-to-end tests relied on specific response shapes (roles ordering, stop token behavior, logprobs fields, and SSE chunk boundaries). This PR unifies behavior, fixes streaming stability issues, and adds compatibility tests.
commits: a1b2c3: compat(openai): normalize `roles` handling and conversation ordering
d4e5f6: api(compat): add stop token semantics + exact-match precedence
09ab7c: runtime(stream): stabilize SSE chunking for chat streaming responses
1f2e3d: compat(functions): map OpenAI function call format to internal tool-call RPC
4c5b6a: tests: add end-to-end parity tests and fixtures for stop/logprobs/roles
7d8e9f: docs: add migration notes and examples for parity layer
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Left a few nits and one functional question - does stop token behavior prefer earliest match or longest match? Please add explicit tests.
Jordan Liu: Reply: We implement earliest-match precedence to match OpenAI. Added tests in tests/unit/test_stop_token.py and an E2E fixture covering multiple-stop cases.
Marcelo Ramos: Streaming fix looks good; can we add a small benchmark to ensure chunk size change doesn't regress latency under high qps?
Jordan Liu: Added a perf note and a gating CI job that runs a quick canary throughput check in workflows/ci/openai-compat.yml. Benchmark results included in PR description.
Liang Chen: Function-call mapping looks correct, but ensure we preserve `name` vs `id` fields for tools registered in dedicated/private deployments.
Jordan Liu: Updated function_call_mapper to carry both fields where available and fallback to name. Added unit tests covering private installer tool metadata.
Sofia Morales: Approve after nits addressed. Verified integration tests locally.
Release-Bot: merge-ready after green CI. No conflicts with release branch.
